# gpg_secret_backend (Resource)

Mounts the gpg secrets engine. Optionally registers the plugin in the catalog first when a sha256 is given.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Mount a plugin that is already registered in the catalog.
resource "gpg_secret_backend" "gpg" {
  path        = "gpg"
  description = "OpenPGP keys"
}

# Register the binary in the server's plugin_directory, then mount it.
variable "plugin_sha256" {
  type = string
}

resource "gpg_secret_backend" "registered" {
  path    = "gpg-registered"
  sha256  = var.plugin_sha256
  command = "vault-plugin-secrets-gpg"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Mount path for the gpg secrets engine (e.g. "gpg"). Changing this forces a new mount.

### Optional

- `command` (String) Plugin binary filename (relative to the server plugin_directory) used when registering. Defaults to the plugin name. Only used when sha256 is set.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the mount.
- `plugin` (String) Registered plugin name (mount type). Defaults to vault-plugin-secrets-gpg. Changing this forces a new mount.
- `sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the plugin binary. When set, the plugin is (re)registered in the catalog before mounting; omit if the plugin is already registered out of band.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by mount path.
terraform import gpg_secret_backend.gpg gpg
```
